name: Locked SG12+DenseCRF, SG14 complementarity and SG15 prior-driven SPEC32 refinement
track: W class-word only; no learned or released optimized tokens
reliability: leave-one-out cosine of raw propagation vectors; stable call-major/head-minor tie order
partition: canonical SG13/SG4 SPEC32; no partition tuning
prior_threshold_policy: SG15 uses each unrefined prior's training-fold optimum; full VOC optimum frozen for COCO. Refinements never choose a new prior threshold.
region_fraction_resolution: annotation resolution; native SPEC32 labels expanded nearest; prior map minmax at64 then bilinear; no boundary blur after refinement
selection: unchanged training-only promotion guards; >=4/5 votes and positive selected OOF; paired forced-candidate OOF also reported
validation: same-generation algebraic/control checks required; historical counts retained as drift diagnostics, never an unconditional cross-hardware gate
storage: atomic per-image counts and reduced diagnostic sidecars; small representative visual caches only; no dataset-wide masks or attention
